title: Demoniac TV
description:
Demoniac TV is a roguelike where you exterminate various demons and fallen angels in waves. Equip yourself with weapons and upgrades and create the best strategy to survive this hell. In this battle, you will have to exorcise everything from the smallest demon to the seraphim.Kill, kill, kill!
You'll have to exorcize 12 types of demons. Good luck!Build your strategy
There are a lot of different upgrades. The arena will be chaotic!Compete online
Demoniac TV has a ranked mode, where you will have the opportunity to compete on a leaderboard with the best demon hunters in the world!
description_short: Destroy demoniac TVs with crazy powerups! Demoniac TV is a roguelite with a cyberpunk look that has its game flow in waves. Kill, buy weapons and become stronger! In this mission, exorcising is your final destination.
